title: Boss Challenge: Sound Master
summary: Ten problems on longitudinal waves, v = fλ, echoes, ultrasound and the ear. Three lives!

ib.note: Unit summative-style task (Criteria A, C and D)

objectives: I can solve problems with v = fλ and T = 1/f.
I can use echo times to find distances.
I can explain uses of ultrasound and how the ear works.
misconceptions: Echo time gives the one-way distance.
Sound can travel in a vacuum.
